messages:
Nina R: Heads-up 1: we need to finalize the SI onboarding playbook before next Monday. Key bits: hardware checklist, cert flow, marketplace walkthrough, and press coordination.
Omar: I can own the hardware checklist. Quick Q: do we require firmware locked images or just a baseline build?
Tess: Baseline build + documented firmware versions. Field teams asked for a preflight script too.
Will A: I can produce the preflight script. Suggest it checks: driver version, runtime hash, and model checksum.
Nina R: Perfect. Add these items to the playbook section: `preflight.sh`, recovery steps, contact matrix, and escalation tags.
Omar: Shipping note: we should include a spare PCIe riser and 2x power cables in each kit. Last round had one missing.
Tess: Noted 1. I will update the packing list template. Also adding a one-page cheat sheet for SI engineers (commands + expected p95s).
ops-bot: Reminder: create internal doc `si-playbook/v1.2` and lock editing for 24 hours when ready.
Nina R: For certification, proposal: 3 modules (runtime ops, marketplace integration, security & privacy). Pass = complete labs + short proctored quiz. Thoughts?
Will A: Keep the quiz lightweight. Make the practical lab the gating factor. Also include a badge asset and short blurb for partner portals.
Omar: Marketplace lab: partner must submit a fake listing and pass privacy checklist (diagram showing no PII egress). Security needs to sign off on the checklist template.
Tess: I can draft the privacy checklist and a minimal data-flow SVG.
Nina R: Marketing wants a joint announcement window. If cohorts finish by Fri, we can co-announce Tue. Contingency = partner-only announce without press.
Will A: Demo runbook: 10-min run, 3-min Q&A, slides + live call to API using `rdw-client`. I will draft script and timeline.
Omar: Action items:
- Omar: update packing list + confirm spare parts in procurement by EOD
- Tess: privacy checklist + cheat sheet draft by 18:00
- Will: demo script + preflight script `preflight.sh` by 16:00
- Nina: coordinate security sign-off + partner PR cadence
ops-bot: Note: set calendar block for dry-run Tue 15:00 PT if artifacts ready.
Nina R: If anyone hits a blocker, post here. Otherwise I will merge the playbook and ping the SI leads tomorrow. :rocket:
